_comment: OPTIONAL third-party connectors (user's own account required). The Cureonics-fleet MCPs (brand-verify · color-a11y · type-foundry · brand-asset-registry · culture-linguistics · regulated-claims · socius-vigil) are already WIRED in `.mcp.json` with Doppler-injected Bearer keys — they load automatically in a `doppler run -p cureohub -c dev_personal -- claude` session and degrade gracefully (to brand-maker offline scripts) when a key is absent. The entries below are NOT wired by default: they need YOUR own Figma/GoDaddy/Exa credentials. To activate one, merge it into `.mcp.json` (or connect it in Claude.ai) and supply the auth.

figma._use: figma-forge (DS-to-Figma libraries, variables, Code Connect) and brand-visual (visual identity handoff to Figma). Needs your Figma auth.

godaddy._use: brand-maker — an alternative live domain-availability source during naming validation (brand-verify-mcp's RDAP+WHOIS is the wired default; GoDaddy is an optional extra needing your GoDaddy API key).

exa._use: brand-audit / brand-market-signal — optional semantic-web enrichment (needs your Exa key). socius-vigil already enriches via Exa server-side.
